# Trimble Civil Site Management

- **Product:** Trimble Civil Site Management (Construction software family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** not declared in the definition (401 responses are defined); Trimble Identity per the product docs. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Customer.
- **To call it you would need:** a Civil Site Management subscription and credentials accepted by https://cloud.api.trimble.com/site-management/v1.
- **Documented servers:** `https://cloud.api.trimble.com/site-management/v1`.
- **Definition:** [civil-site-management/v1](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/civil-site-management/openapi/v1.yaml) (Site Management API, version v1). Documentation: https://developer.trimble.com/docs/civil-site-management/reference/openapi/v1/.
